description: GlassTerm is a native macOS terminal emulator written in Swift and AppKit, with zero external dependencies. No packages, no third-party code.
The window is a sheet of glass over your wallpaper: NSVisualEffectView chrome with adjustable blur, tint, saturation, corner radius, and padding, all editable live in Settings with a preview.

Underneath the glass is a real terminal: forkpty process handling, a VT100/xterm parser with scrollback, and configurable fonts, cursor, and line spacing. Config lives in ~/.config/glassterm/config.json.
